content.short: A digital gallery that supports scientific mycological research.
content.description:
We are a digital gallery that supports scientific mycological research. We are passionate about mycology and believe that fungi play a crucial role in the future of technology, our species and our planet. Which is why we are compelled to give a portion of our profits to research groups that further our understanding. This exhibition saw $100k+ donated to MAPS.

We feature only the highest quality artists and partner with them to deliver innovative and highly collectable pieces to the market. Our first collection ‘Pioneers’ has been created by our own creative director and long term Cardano supporter Projekt. His work can be seen throughout the Cardano ecosystem and has produced work for IOHK, Emurgo, Cardano Foundation along with numerous stake pools.
